fields.Name: T349 - Dependency Graph Entity Select and Relationships
fields.Description: Exercises entity-relationship derivation from live metadata (buildReferencedByList/buildDependsOnList/countReferencedBy) on SelectEntity — fully data-agnostic since it reads always-present entity metadata, not seed rows.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Version History app → 'Dependency Graph' (left nav), confirm stat badges (entities / with dependents / relationships) and a scrollable entity list. Select an entity from the list (use the filter box to find a common one like 'Users' if needed) and confirm the detail panel populates with 'Referenced By' and 'Depends On' sections listing related entities (one side may show a valid 'no relationships' state). Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. This works regardless of stored data.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Dependency Graph shows entity stat badges and a list of entities
Selecting an entity populates a detail panel with 'Referenced By' and 'Depends On' sections
Each section lists related entities or shows a valid 'no relationships' empty state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
